title: M0 Audit Entry
description: Schema for LineOS M0 audit log entries (NDJSON format). Authority: M0 Constitution v2.0 §03.5

event_type.description: One of the 7 canonical M0 audit event types

level.description: audit = security-relevant event; info = operational; warn/error = degradation

metadata.description: Structured metadata. For asset_served: path + digest (never content). For policy_violation: destination + reason.
